title: Scope Geography
description: The geography axis of a scoped keyFeatures entry: 'Global', 'cross-region', an ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country code, or an author-defined region label.
$comment: Deliberately an open string rather than an enum. Region labels are free-form by design -- geography.v1's 'regions' keys are kept as named in the source publication -- so a closed list could not express labels this repo already uses, e.g. IEA's 'Asia Pacific', 'Eurasia', 'Middle East', 'Central and South America', none of which appear in geographyItem.v1's enum. (#858's scope text says geographyItem, which would reject any finer-scope entry on an IEA pathway.) 'Global' is the widest sentinel; 'cross-region' is reserved for a multi-region non-global aggregate. Because any non-blank string validates here, the real constraint -- that the value is 'Global', 'cross-region', or a region/country the pathway declares in its own 'geography' -- is enforced by validateScopedEntries in src/utils/validateScopes.ts, run from scripts/schema-check-files.ts. That check is what catches a mistyped label.
